# Third-party replays

68 TH16 1.00a replays by other players, used to check that our builds play
the game like the original (docs/workflow.md, "Replay check of the MSVC
build"; on the port branch, port/NOTES.md, "Replay sync tests"). Each is a
1cc, recorded without continues (the game does not save a replay after a
continue): one all clear for every character, season and difficulty, and an
Extra clear for each character. Each is the highest-scoring all clear of
its kind in the archive, except Easy Marisa Spring: the archive failed to
serve the top one (th16_ud060d), so it is the second.

They come from [Royalflare](https://maribelhearn.com/royalflare), the
Touhou scoreboard that collected replays from 2007 until it closed in 2022,
through Maribel Hearn's archive of it. The replays are the players' own
work; they are here unchanged except for the file names, and credited
below with the name they used on Royalflare (and the name saved in the
replay where it differs), the score, the date and the comment they posted,
and a link to the archived original. If you are one of these players and
would like your replay removed, open an issue.

Players: Aya, Firerat, HRS, Iku, Lutino, MTR, Marisa, Raymario Pokénic, fon, idtn, kkkn, mdzz, yuushaou, おいたん, ひろ♪☆, みょん吉, リュウG, レックス, 園田琴梨, Ｋ・Ｇ.
